recommendation: Do not promote as a default check on this evidence. Keep prototype for targeted serialization-heavy corpora or optional framework checks.
limitations: JSON value shapes only; not all Serde formats or duplicate-key document behavior.
No cross-file type resolution or macro expansion; generic/recursive/unknown types abstain.
Flatten, aliases, custom deserialization/default functions and conditional variant/field attributes abstain.
No claim that a nonfinding proves enum variants are reachable.
Findings require full shape inclusion; partial overlap is deliberately not reported.
